evidence.assertion: host simulation, Opus/budget gates and tagged Go backend regression passed on clean GitHub runner
go mod tidy produced zero diff after dependency lock; go mod verify passed
module reproducibility, vet/race and govulncheck quality workflow passed
CodeQL Go manual traced build and analysis passed with adk,mcp,webrtc,nolibopusfile adapters
INMP441 peak/RMS respond dynamically to sound on ESP32-S3

real_voice_e2e.reason: Mock/fake voice paths are useful regression tests but do not count as production voice evidence. A real ESP32/network run with real ASR, real LLM and real TTS is still required.

real_asr_quality.reason: No Vietnamese/English real-ASR WER/CER benchmark has been recorded.

real_tts_quality.reason: No real streaming-TTS latency/quality benchmark has been recorded.

real_llm_tool_quality.reason: Deterministic routing/fake-model tests exist but real-model task success, tool selection and argument accuracy have not been measured.

prompt_regression_eval.reason: Versioned/composable prompt bundle v4 is implemented, but no real-model prompt regression/red-team benchmark has promoted it.

destructive_tool_confirmation.reason: Authorization core now scopes confirmation by owner + exact tool + canonical args hash + expiry, but durable user confirmation issuance/consumption and adversarial E2E are not yet proven.

idempotency_payload_conflict.reason: Current persistence semantics do not yet prove same-key/different-payload conflict detection across retries/concurrency.

postgres_migrations_jobs.reason: PostgreSQL/Atlas/Ent/River migration, crash/restart and backup/restore gates are not yet complete on main.

webrtc_real_network.reason: Pion WebRTC Opus adapter compiles under production tags, but no real-network latency/loss benchmark has been recorded.

mcp_external_integration.reason: Official MCP Go SDK bridge is implemented behind the Companion ToolRegistry/policy boundary, but real external MCP server interoperability/security tests are pending.

protocol_v2_negotiation.reason: Protocol/capability negotiation v2 has not been production-proven.

security_default_deny.reason: Security CI is green, but deployment-default auth/origin/TLS and adversarial integration gates are not yet fully proven.

privacy_explicit_consent.reason: Explicit retention/memory consent and deletion behavior still require end-to-end proof.

real_device_24h_soak.reason: 24h+ physical ESP32 soak/fault-injection evidence has not been recorded.
